responsibility: Implements the IOChan utility accessors as thin wrappers over lower-level runtime channel storage. It delegates ChanId-to-file extraction to RTio.GetFile and derives a newly allocated filename string through SFIO.GetFileName on that file handle, thereby bridging the abstract IOChan layer to concrete FIO file metadata without adding device dispatch, parsing, or formatting behavior of its own.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation module for IOChanUtils: it provides the executable bodies of GetFileName and GetFile, specifically wiring ChanId access to RTio.GetFile and SFIO.GetFileName. Unlike the same-stem definition file, it contains the concrete runtime bridging logic rather than just the exported interface.
